search: 30 years of Nvidia graphics cards collection tour

hook: One of Jensen Huang's die-hard fans has collected *30 years of graphics cards*, from his very first in 1995 to latest in 2025
caption:
A collector known online as ornstein6990 lined up Nvidia's flagship graphics cards on shelves, from the NV1 of 1995 to the RTX 5090.
Every card has a small plaque with its name, architecture and release year.
The rare NV1 was the most expensive card to find, and the owner says the whole collection cost under $10,000.
